TOOLING BURST T4u — T4u — G4 self-aura loop (Healing Hands) (Run C-5, E3; architecture 03- § 2.2 grammars, § 2.3 alphabet; specs are conductor-authored with VERIFY flags — implement the spec as written and report any field that the primitives or the runtime cannot honour). task_id "T4u".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4a, T4b, T4f, T4h (all clauses), T4p, T4q, T4r and the new row "T4u — G4 self-aura loop (Healing Hands)" (your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. runs/C-5/specs/healing_hands.json (the specs — LAW: the renderer never selects targets or infers grammar from a name), export/effect_kit.py, export/godot_import.py (G1 component, pieces phase, screen_px, key states, T4r's burst_v1r + decal), export/vfx_material.gdshader, oracle/peak_pieces.py (run only), the primitives (512 working copies, four-plane greyscale RGBA unless noted): VF-prim-holy-ring-01/holy_ring_01_512.png, VF-prim-holy-petal-01/holy_petal_01_512.png, VF-prim-holy-seal-01/holy_seal_01_512.png, runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_bolt_e1_B/kit.json and ice_bolt_e2/kit.json (templates), tests/test_effect_kit.py, tests/test_godot_import.py, tests/test_vfx_picker.py (extend only).
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only (rendered = conductor's).

BUILD the G4 grammar as a runtime component `scenes/vfx/g4_aura_loop.tscn` + script: (1) OWNER-TRACKING — the aura is parented to the caster's root and follows it; (2) SEAL — the interrupted-seal sprite on the ground layer under the caster (MIX, already foreshortened: scale 1.0, no extra squash), rotating slowly (one turn per 8 s), alpha 0.8; (3) RING — 5 broken-ring segments orbiting the caster's feet on an ellipse (radius_px × 0.58 vertical) with the spec's orbit period, evenly spaced, each on the T4a material (ADD), sorted behind the caster when above the feet line and in front when below; (4) PULSES — on each entry of the spec's irregular pulse schedule (CV ≥ 0.25 asserted), 6 folded-ray petals rise from random points on the ring (upright bodies, 0.45 s life: scale 0.6 → 1.0, alpha 1 → 0 by dissolve band order 3,2,1+0 in the last third), and every actor inside radius_px gets the support-preset tint (a pale gold tint, not the victim red) + a heal label "+" (T4f label path); (5) duration_s then release: the ring segments erode outside-in over 0.3 s, the seal fades; stack = refresh (a recast restarts the clock, never doubles the aura); (6) kit `healing_hands_e3` registered (screen_px; support preset: halo + floor light, dark duplicate OFF).
ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-5/t3/T4u/acceptance.json): headless trace: cast, walk the caster 200 px east during the loop — seal and ring follow within 1 frame; pulse count and interval CV per the spec; petal lifetimes; tint/label events on a dummy inside the radius and none outside; recast during the loop refreshes (one aura, clock reset); release timing; kit validates; previously registered kits byte-identical; in-sandbox suite reds named.
TEST ALIGNMENT FIRST (conductor R-C5-68, £0): one T4s-r3 test asserts an exact global scale and fails by ~6e-8 from rotation decomposition — give it a 1e-5 tolerance (name it in acceptance). Any other test that still encodes pre-T4s-r3 G2 node trees (density/decal expectations Astra flagged as stale) is re-encoded against the current emission.

Tests (unittest, stdlib): kit validation; the emitted scenes contain the named nodes; headless clock traces per the ACCEPTANCE; all previously registered kits export byte-identically; headless import exit 0.
DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, fixtures/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/ (run only), export/replay.py, any test file except the three named (extend only), anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/T4u/, the new kit directories named above and their registration lines in kits_v9.json. Do not run git. Temporary files ONLY under runs/C-5/t3/T4u/. Write out/files.json listing every file you changed with sha256.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T4u"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
